Blender，建模、绑定、真实感渲染都能做。

tweet.text:
🔥 昨天分享的 Antigravity 工具提效帖子爆了

那工具用顺了之后，我觉得真正拉开差距的就是自媒体创作工作流的提效。

简单复盘一下我自己现在在用的 14 个开源 Skill，按「选题 → 素材 → 写稿 → 去 AI 味 → 配图 → 发布」串成了一条线，每一步都有对应的工具。

1、选题：今天写什么

AIHOT：AI 方向的日报，模型发布、产品更新、新论文分好类摆出来，匿名只读，不用 API Key
https://t.co/EWOoEwvIrL

2、素材：找对标、扒内容

Agent Reach：一句话搜 YouTube、X、B站、小红书、公众号等十几个平台，扒字幕、读帖子
https://t.co/uXingPaa1X

安装：把这句发给 Agent
帮我安装 Agent Reach：https://t.co/eWByrBfSPG

blogger-distiller：拆解对标博主的爆款打法
https://t.co/LGodi5YIav

video-to-subtitle-summary-skill：视频链接丢进去，出字幕和摘要
https://t.co/k6TrcsYsL8

3、写稿

ViralWriterSkill：标题和正文一起出
https://t.co/i6IbK0TeNU

WeChat-Official-Account-content-studio：公众号从热点、选题、写作、排版到推送草稿，一条龙
https://t.co/92hbFFi6TY

xiaohongshu-ops-skill：小红书账号定位、选题研究、竞品对标
https://t.co/EyclPBUZuw

4、诊断 + 去 AI 味（其实本身 Gemini 4 写出来的文案已经很好了）

dbs：开头没钩子、标题起不好，说一句「帮我看看」，它自动路由到对应的子工具，还带 AI 味检测
https://t.co/HFuprmpjUy

检测出问题后，改写交给 Humanizer-zh
https://t.co/BkKzY133XX

或者 remove-ai-flavor
https://t.co/l2eHolTvfr

5、配图

guizang-social-card-skill：文章扔进去，小红书 3:4 图文、公众号 21:9 头图 + 1:1 分享卡一套出齐。本地 HTML 渲染，不用生图 API
https://t.co/I2Dbty0jbE

article-visual-director：给正文配图，先判断哪些交给 AI 画、哪些用 HTML 精确排字
https://t.co/WdR4Mj3Afs

gpt-image-2-prompting-skill：需要 AI 画的图，把提示词写成一份视觉 brief
https://t.co/5RZY4MKgDt

6、视频 & 演示

seedance-prompt：生成 Seedance 2.0 视频提示词
https://t.co/rLnNilJmvC

guizang-ppt-skill：杂志风 HTML 网页 PPT，适合做教程长图和分享课件
https://t.co/I7D88rnlSf

7、发布

小红书：xiaohongshu-ops-skill，浏览器自动化发布
公众号：content-studio 推送到草稿箱
X：opencli，复用已登录的 Chrome 去点击、填表、发帖
https://t.co/fQXVXSZnSg

分工就一句话：Agent Reach 负责读，opencli 负责点。

 几个坑先说清楚

Agent Reach 只读不写，X 和小红书要配自己的 cookies，「不用配 API」只说对了一半

opencli 自动发 X 有风控风险，主号建议最后一步人工点发送

gpt-image-2-prompting、seedance-prompt 只出提示词，出图、出视频还得自己接 API 或手动贴

dbs 只检测 AI 味，不负责改写

guizang 的两个 Skill 都是 AGPL-3.0，商用或二次分发前先看清协议

工具只能帮你省时间，涨粉还是看选题判断和能不能持续发。

你现在的自媒体工作流卡在哪一步？评论区聊聊 🔥 还在嫌 Antigravity 不好用？大概率是这几个开源插件没装

挑选合适自己的装上，看额度、看界面、切账号、写代码都顺手很多，说效率翻倍不算夸张

提速 & 写代码

1、agy-fast
专门给 Antigravity 提速的插件，目标是降低延迟、减少工具调用次数
把搜索、多处编辑、分段读文件、跑测试/lint 合成 4 个 MCP 工具，Agent 少走很多来回
CLI、Desktop 2.0、IDE 都能用，零依赖，MIT
https://t.co/w66Scc5u1I

2、Ponytail
让 AI 像「最懒的资深开发者」一样干活：能不写的代码就不写
还带 /ponytail-review 审改动、/ponytail-audit 审整个仓库
官方基准说代码量少约 53%、token 少约 45%（项目方数据）
Antigravity CLI 支持全部命令
https://t.co/nYKxePW8T1

额度 & 用量

3、agy-powertools
功能最全的一个：输入框旁边显示上下文占用、缓存复用、生成速度
另外有用量看板、会话分支、发出去的消息能原地改了重发
多账号切换和免 XX 也有，默认是关着的
https://t.co/qo8al5fvBS

4、Antigravity Panel
不用等额度耗光才发现，侧栏里就能看各模型还剩多少额度、什么时候重置
还能看用量趋势和上下文占用，支持中文
https://t.co/PvNEZs7eOQ

汉化

5、antigravity2-cn
Antigravity 2.0 的汉化，菜单、设置、登录页、新手引导都有覆盖
简繁两套词库，首次安装自动备份，可一键还原
https://t.co/pmQvb00gL2

6、Antigravity Chinese
另一套汉化，菜单、设置、权限弹窗都有覆盖，支持备份还原
已经跟进 Windows 2.31.2
https://t.co/o3eMSxT3vR

多账号

7、Paragravity
有多个账号的，不用反复退出登录了
每个账号单独开一个窗口，会话各自独立，也能继承部分配置，Windows 和 Mac 都能用
https://t.co/RnDVrQn2Jc

个人建议：agy-fast + Ponytail 管效率，再挑一个看额度的、看不惯英文的汉化一下，基本上效率绝对有提升。

1、agy-fast

Antigravity CLI 支持全部命令
https://t.co/nYKxePW8T1

https://t.co/o3eMSxT3vR

1、选题：今天写什么

AIHOT：AI 方向的日报，模型发布、产品更新、新论文分好类摆出来，匿名只读，不用 API Key
https://t.co/EWOoEwvIrL

2、素材：找对标、扒内容

Agent Reach：一句话搜 YouTube、X、B站、小红书、公众号等十几个平台，扒字幕、读帖子
https://t.co/uXingPaa1X

安装：把这句发给 Agent
帮我安装 Agent Reach：https://t.co/eWByrBfSPG

blogger-distiller：拆解对标博主的爆款打法
https://t.co/LGodi5YIav

video-to-subtitle-summary-skill：视频链接丢进去，出字幕和摘要
https://t.co/k6TrcsYsL8

3、写稿

ViralWriterSkill：标题和正文一起出
https://t.co/i6IbK0TeNU

WeChat-Official-Account-content-studio：公众号从热点、选题、写作、排版到推送草稿，一条龙
https://t.co/92hbFFi6TY

xiaohongshu-ops-skill：小红书账号定位、选题研究、竞品对标
https://t.co/EyclPBUZuw

4、诊断 + 去 AI 味（其实本身 Gemini 4 写出来的文案已经很好了）

dbs：开头没钩子、标题起不好，说一句「帮我看看」，它自动路由到对应的子工具，还带 AI 味检测
https://t.co/HFuprmpjUy

检测出问题后，改写交给 Humanizer-zh
https://t.co/BkKzY133XX

或者 remove-ai-flavor
https://t.co/l2eHolTvfr

5、配图

guizang-social-card-skill：文章扔进去，小红书 3:4 图文、公众号 21:9 头图 + 1:1 分享卡一套出齐。本地 HTML 渲染，不用生图 API
https://t.co/I2Dbty0jbE

article-visual-director：给正文配图，先判断哪些交给 AI 画、哪些用 HTML 精确排字
https://t.co/WdR4Mj3Afs

gpt-image-2-prompting-skill：需要 AI 画的图，把提示词写成一份视觉 brief
https://t.co/5RZY4MKgDt

6、视频 & 演示

seedance-prompt：生成 Seedance 2.0 视频提示词
https://t.co/rLnNilJmvC

guizang-ppt-skill：杂志风 HTML 网页 PPT，适合做教程长图和分享课件
https://t.co/I7D88rnlSf

小红书：xiaohongshu-ops-skill，浏览器自动化发布
公众号：content-studio 推送到草稿箱
X：opencli，复用已登录的 Chrome 去点击、填表、发帖
https://t.co/fQXVXSZnSg

分工就一句话：Agent Reach 负责读，opencli 负责点。

 几个坑先说清楚

Agent Reach 只读不写，X 和小红书要配自己的 cookies，「不用配 API」只说对了一半

opencli 自动发 X 有风控风险，主号建议最后一步人工点发送

dbs 只检测 AI 味，不负责改写

guizang 的两个 Skill 都是 AGPL-3.0，商用或二次分发前先看清协议

那工具用顺了之后，我觉得真正拉开差距的就是自媒体创作工作流的提效。

简单复盘一下我自己现在在用的 14 个开源 Skill，按「选题 → 素材 → 写稿 → 去 AI 味 → 配图 → 发布」串成了一条线，每一步都有对应的工具。

1、选题：今天写什么

AIHOT：AI 方向的日报，模型发布、产品更新、新论文分好类摆出来，匿名只读，不用 API Key
https://t.co/EWOoEwvIrL

2、素材：找对标、扒内容

Agent Reach：一句话搜 YouTube、X、B站、小红书、公众号等十几个平台，扒字幕、读帖子
https://t.co/uXingPaa1X

安装：把这句发给 Agent
帮我安装 Agent Reach：https://t.co/eWByrBfSPG

blogger-distiller：拆解对标博主的爆款打法
https://t.co/LGodi5YIav

video-to-subtitle-summary-skill：视频链接丢进去，出字幕和摘要
https://t.co/k6TrcsYsL8

3、写稿

ViralWriterSkill：标题和正文一起出
https://t.co/i6IbK0TeNU

WeChat-Official-Account-content-studio：公众号从热点、选题、写作、排版到推送草稿，一条龙
https://t.co/92hbFFi6TY

xiaohongshu-ops-skill：小红书账号定位、选题研究、竞品对标
https://t.co/EyclPBUZuw

4、诊断 + 去 AI 味（其实本身 Gemini 4 写出来的文案已经很好了）

dbs：开头没钩子、标题起不好，说一句「帮我看看」，它自动路由到对应的子工具，还带 AI 味检测
https://t.co/HFuprmpjUy

检测出问题后，改写交给 Humanizer-zh
https://t.co/BkKzY133XX

或者 remove-ai-flavor
https://t.co/l2eHolTvfr

5、配图

guizang-social-card-skill：文章扔进去，小红书 3:4 图文、公众号 21:9 头图 + 1:1 分享卡一套出齐。本地 HTML 渲染，不用生图 API
https://t.co/I2Dbty0jbE

article-visual-director：给正文配图，先判断哪些交给 AI 画、哪些用 HTML 精确排字
https://t.co/WdR4Mj3Afs

gpt-image-2-prompting-skill：需要 AI 画的图，把提示词写成一份视觉 brief
https://t.co/5RZY4MKgDt

6、视频 & 演示

seedance-prompt：生成 Seedance 2.0 视频提示词
https://t.co/rLnNilJmvC

guizang-ppt-skill：杂志风 HTML 网页 PPT，适合做教程长图和分享课件
https://t.co/I7D88rnlSf

7、发布

小红书：xiaohongshu-ops-skill，浏览器自动化发布
公众号：content-studio 推送到草稿箱
X：opencli，复用已登录的 Chrome 去点击、填表、发帖
https://t.co/fQXVXSZnSg

分工就一句话：Agent Reach 负责读，opencli 负责点。

 几个坑先说清楚

Agent Reach 只读不写，X 和小红书要配自己的 cookies，「不用配 API」只说对了一半

opencli 自动发 X 有风控风险，主号建议最后一步人工点发送

gpt-image-2-prompting、seedance-prompt 只出提示词，出图、出视频还得自己接 API 或手动贴

dbs 只检测 AI 味，不负责改写

guizang 的两个 Skill 都是 AGPL-3.0，商用或二次分发前先看清协议

工具只能帮你省时间，涨粉还是看选题判断和能不能持续发。

你现在的自媒体工作流卡在哪一步？评论区聊聊 🔥 还在嫌 Antigravity 不好用？大概率是这几个开源插件没装

挑选合适自己的装上，看额度、看界面、切账号、写代码都顺手很多，说效率翻倍不算夸张

提速 & 写代码

1、agy-fast
专门给 Antigravity 提速的插件，目标是降低延迟、减少工具调用次数
把搜索、多处编辑、分段读文件、跑测试/lint 合成 4 个 MCP 工具，Agent 少走很多来回
CLI、Desktop 2.0、IDE 都能用，零依赖，MIT
https://t.co/w66Scc5u1I

2、Ponytail
让 AI 像「最懒的资深开发者」一样干活：能不写的代码就不写
还带 /ponytail-review 审改动、/ponytail-audit 审整个仓库
官方基准说代码量少约 53%、token 少约 45%（项目方数据）
Antigravity CLI 支持全部命令
https://t.co/nYKxePW8T1

额度 & 用量

3、agy-powertools
功能最全的一个：输入框旁边显示上下文占用、缓存复用、生成速度
另外有用量看板、会话分支、发出去的消息能原地改了重发
多账号切换和免 XX 也有，默认是关着的
https://t.co/qo8al5fvBS

4、Antigravity Panel
不用等额度耗光才发现，侧栏里就能看各模型还剩多少额度、什么时候重置
还能看用量趋势和上下文占用，支持中文
https://t.co/PvNEZs7eOQ

汉化

5、antigravity2-cn
Antigravity 2.0 的汉化，菜单、设置、登录页、新手引导都有覆盖
简繁两套词库，首次安装自动备份，可一键还原
https://t.co/pmQvb00gL2

6、Antigravity Chinese
另一套汉化，菜单、设置、权限弹窗都有覆盖，支持备份还原
已经跟进 Windows 2.31.2
https://t.co/o3eMSxT3vR

多账号

7、Paragravity
有多个账号的，不用反复退出登录了
每个账号单独开一个窗口，会话各自独立，也能继承部分配置，Windows 和 Mac 都能用
https://t.co/RnDVrQn2Jc

个人建议：agy-fast + Ponytail 管效率，再挑一个看额度的、看不惯英文的汉化一下，基本上效率绝对有提升。

ViralWriterSkill：标题和正文一起出

https://t.co/92hbFFi6TY

xiaohongshu-ops-skill：小红书账号定位、选题研究、竞品对标
https://t.co/EyclPBUZuw

4、诊断 + 去 AI 味（其实本身 Gemini 4 写出来的文案已经很好了）

dbs：开头没钩子、标题起不好，说一句「帮我看看」，它自动路由到对应的子工具，还带 AI 味检测
https://t.co/HFuprmpjUy

检测出问题后，改写交给 Humanizer-zh
https://t.co/BkKzY133XX

或者 remove-ai-flavor
https://t.co/l2eHolTvfr

5、配图

guizang-social-card-skill：文章扔进去，小红书 3:4 图文、公众号 21:9 头图 + 1:1 分享卡一套出齐。本地 HTML 渲染，不用生图 API
https://t.co/I2Dbty0jbE

article-visual-director：给正文配图，先判断哪些交给 AI 画、哪些用 HTML 精确排字
https://t.co/WdR4Mj3Afs

gpt-image-2-prompting-skill：需要 AI 画的图，把提示词写成一份视觉 brief
https://t.co/5RZY4MKgDt

6、视频 & 演示

seedance-prompt：生成 Seedance 2.0 视频提示词
https://t.co/rLnNilJmvC

guizang-ppt-skill：杂志风 HTML 网页 PPT，适合做教程长图和分享课件
https://t.co/I7D88rnlSf

小红书：xiaohongshu-ops-skill，浏览器自动化发布
公众号：content-studio 推送到草稿箱
X：opencli，复用已登录的 Chrome 去点击、填表、发帖
https://t.co/fQXVXSZnSg

分工就一句话：Agent Reach 负责读，opencli 负责点。

 几个坑先说清楚

Agent Reach 只读不写，X 和小红书要配自己的 cookies，「不用配 API」只说对了一半

opencli 自动发 X 有风控风险，主号建议最后一步人工点发送

gpt-image-2-prompting、seedance-prompt 只出提示词，出图、出视频还得自己接 API 或手动贴

dbs 只检测 AI 味，不负责改写

guizang 的两个 Skill 都是 AGPL-3.0，商用或二次分发前先看清协议

工具只能帮你省时间，涨粉还是看选题判断和能不能持续发。

你现在的自媒体工作流卡在哪一步？评论区聊聊 🔥 还在嫌 Antigravity 不好用？大概率是这几个开源插件没装

挑选合适自己的装上，看额度、看界面、切账号、写代码都顺手很多，说效率翻倍不算夸张

提速 & 写代码

1、agy-fast
专门给 Antigravity 提速的插件，目标是降低延迟、减少工具调用次数
把搜索、多处编辑、分段读文件、跑测试/lint 合成 4 个 MCP 工具，Agent 少走很多来回
CLI、Desktop 2.0、IDE 都能用，零依赖，MIT
https://t.co/w66Scc5u1I

2、Ponytail
让 AI 像「最懒的资深开发者」一样干活：能不写的代码就不写
还带 /ponytail-review 审改动、/ponytail-audit 审整个仓库
官方基准说代码量少约 53%、token 少约 45%（项目方数据）
Antigravity CLI 支持全部命令
https://t.co/nYKxePW8T1

额度 & 用量

3、agy-powertools
功能最全的一个：输入框旁边显示上下文占用、缓存复用、生成速度
另外有用量看板、会话分支、发出去的消息能原地改了重发
多账号切换和免 XX 也有，默认是关着的
https://t.co/qo8al5fvBS

4、Antigravity Panel
不用等额度耗光才发现，侧栏里就能看各模型还剩多少额度、什么时候重置
还能看用量趋势和上下文占用，支持中文
https://t.co/PvNEZs7eOQ

汉化

5、antigravity2-cn
Antigravity 2.0 的汉化，菜单、设置、登录页、新手引导都有覆盖
简繁两套词库，首次安装自动备份，可一键还原
https://t.co/pmQvb00gL2

6、Antigravity Chinese
另一套汉化，菜单、设置、权限弹窗都有覆盖，支持备份还原
已经跟进 Windows 2.31.2
https://t.co/o3eMSxT3vR

多账号

7、Paragravity
有多个账号的，不用反复退出登录了
每个账号单独开一个窗口，会话各自独立，也能继承部分配置，Windows 和 Mac 都能用
https://t.co/RnDVrQn2Jc

个人建议：agy-fast + Ponytail 管效率，再挑一个看额度的、看不惯英文的汉化一下，基本上效率绝对有提升。

Antigravity 2.0 的汉化，菜单、设置、登录页、新手引导都有覆盖
简繁两套词库，首次安装自动备份，可一键还原
https://t.co/pmQvb00gL2

另一套汉化，菜单、设置、权限弹窗都有覆盖，支持备份还原

tweet.text:
Catchlight

Animate 2D character parts with realtime 2.5D movement

Catchlight simulates 3D movement by deforming 2D parts. It has its own model format and an importer for inochi2d models.

Face tracking follows shoulder posture too, processes frames locally, and poses the model without saving changes. You can try the editor and face tracking in browser demos.

A React frontend lets you embed the editor, and a Rust crate lets you embed the animation runtime.

https://t.co/oBFPif7M0a

tweet.text:
ODX

Turn aerial and ground photos into maps and 3D models

ODX is a free and open source photogrammetry engine. It produces classified point clouds, textured 3D models, georeferenced orthophotos and digital elevation models.

Images can be extracted automatically from MP4, MOV, LRV and TS videos.

ODX runs on Windows, Mac and Linux, with GPU acceleration for some computations.

Use the command line for scripts and integrations, NodeODM for network access, or WebODM for a graphical interface.

https://t.co/PAqWtrPbWe

A searchable Leonida map that keeps working offline

Find collectibles, activities, services, and named places in GTA 6. Search tolerates typos, and category and district filters narrow the map.

After one visit, cached content works offline.

“Next nearby” takes you to the closest unfound item in the same category within your district filter. Progress links carry your finds to another device.

Anime.js is a JavaScript animation library that works with CSS properties, SVG, DOM attributes and JavaScript objects.

The library is free to use under the MIT license.

repos.description: Your git repo as a pixel-art city that grows along its history.

tweet.text:
gitropolis

Watch your Git repository grow into a pixel art city, commit by commit

Files become buildings and directories become neighbourhoods. The city grows from empty lots to a skyline as you move through the repository's history.

File sizes, directory depth and import relationships shape the layout. Separate monorepo packages become islands.

Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, or explore with the timeline. Export the city as a GIF, MP4 video or PNG still.

repos.name: yifanfeng97/Hyper-Extract
repos.description: Hypergraph is more powerful. Transform unstructured text into structured knowledge with LLMs. Graphs, hypergraphs, and spatio-temporal extractions — with one command.

tweet.text:
没结构的文档堆成山，想变成能查、能追溯的知识库，这难题怎么破？

Hyper-Extract 用的是 LLM 自动提炼，把文本转成结构化知识。

普通图谱、超图、时空图谱等结构，它大约支持 8 种；80 多个领域模板内置其中，金融、法律、医疗、中医全在覆盖范围内。增量演进不在话下，一键导出到 Obsidian 同样办得到。

文档丢进去，关联信息自己就抽出来了，大批文档的场景用它正对路。
🔗https://t.co/cYsSxsg5R6

repos.name: milos-agathon/forge3d
repos.description: Rust‑first, cross‑platform wgpu/WebGPU renderer exposed to Python for fast, headless 3D rendering. Built in Rust, shipped as Python wheels.

tweet.text:
forge3d

Turn real elevation data into print resolution terrain maps from Python

A Rust renderer for Python workflows, with path tracing, global illumination and terrain shadows.

Use prepared arrays or local raster files to turn population data into raised, shaded surfaces or give land cover classes distinct colors.

Styles return legend labels and ranges, and missing cells stay empty.

The quickstart fetches an elevation model, opens an orbitable viewer and saves a snapshot at your chosen resolution.

https://t.co/c5XtP5ba7W

repos.name: iChochy/NCE
repos.description: 《新概念英语》全四册在线课文朗读、单句点读、中英对照

tweet.text:
学《新概念英语》还得翻光盘、对书找音频，真有必要这么折腾吗？

NCE 干脆把全四册做成了纯前端在线点读页面，美音和中英对照全揉在一块儿。

浏览器打开就能用，逐句点着播，手机电脑都适配，跟读比老办法省事不少。四册从零基础铺到高阶，词汇量大概 600 到 4000 词，入门到雅思、托福备考基本够用。

音频放在外部，头一回播可能要缓冲；中文字幕是 AI 生成的，偶尔有点小误差，辅助理解也够。自己的音频和字幕还能外挂，按目录打包塞进同一个播放器就行。
地址：https://t.co/xwVU4MXIo5

tweet.text:
hairmesh

Draw stylized hair as curves, then turn it into a quad mesh

HairMesh is a Blender port of catarackta's Stylized HairMesh Creator, made with the author's permission.

Draw curves over a head point by point or freehand. Walls between neighboring curves form hair locks, which convert into a quad mesh with evenly spaced loops.

You can keep editing the source curves after conversion. Convert again and only changed meshes are rebuilt.

Requires Blender 5.1 or later. Projects stay in .blend files, and you can import .hairmesh files directly.

tweet.text:
copy-paste version, paste it into claude code instead of plan mode:

<prompt>
<goal>
Before any plan, spec or code: interview me about [FEATURE] until we share one understanding of it. Only then write the plan.
</goal>
<role>
Act as Matt Pocock's /grill-me. You ask, I decide. You never start building on a guess.
</role>
<principles>
Adapt these ideas from Matt Pocock's public writing on /grill-me: [1-3]
- Plan mode spits out a plan too early, before we've truly understood each other. Don't. [1]
- His original skill was only 3 sentences. The power is in the rules, not the length. [1]
- Walk every branch of the decision tree and resolve dependencies one at a time. [2]
- If the codebase can answer a question, read the code instead of asking me. [2]
- Give your recommended answer with every question, so I can just say yes. [2]
- Real features take 30, 40, even 50 questions. Don't stop at 5. [1]
- Questions only a running prototype can answer: park them, never guess. [3]
</principles>
<layer_1_map>
Read the parts of the repo this feature touches. List the decisions it needs as a tree, biggest first. Show me the tree before asking anything.
</layer_1_map>
<layer_2_grill>
One question at a time, top of the tree down. Each one: the question, why it matters, your recommended answer. Then wait for my reply.
</layer_2_grill>
<layer_3_terms>
When a word could mean two things, stop and make me pick one name. Keep a running glossary and use only those names.
</layer_3_terms>
<layer_4_parked>
If a question needs working code to answer, add it to a PARKED list with what a prototype would have to show.
</layer_4_parked>
<layer_5_check>
After each branch, sum up what we decided in 3 lines and ask me if it's right.
</layer_5_check>
<rules>
No plan, no file, no code until I say "we're aligned". Never ask what the code already tells you. Never batch questions. If I say "skip", take your recommended answer and log it.
</rules>
<delivery>
When I say "we're aligned": the decision list, the glossary, the PARKED list, then the plan, in that order.
</delivery>
<start>
Run layer 1 for [FEATURE] now and show me the decision tree.
</start>
</prompt>

tweet.text:
This is f*cking insane, with these repos you can turn your Grok Bot into a money printing machine

Not magic, just tools: the Bot finds the clients, does the work, and you get paid
how to start:

1. pick one service people already pay for, like research reports, document summaries or support replies

2. let your Bot search the web for businesses that need it and research each one

3. let it draft a personal message for every lead, you read them and send the good ones

4. they book a call, you do the first job and check the result yourself

5. send a payment link and track every client in one place

the 10 repos that do the real work ↓

-> xai sdk python (by xai-org) the official Python SDK for the xAI API, the base for building your own Grok powered tools https://t.co/xe6jQkK2Xp

-> plugin marketplace (by xai-org) the official xAI plugin marketplace, where you find the plugins your Bot can use https://t.co/5zgeB6M2Xz

-> browser-use (by browser-use) gives your agent a browser, so it finds businesses and their contact pages on the web by itself https://t.co/dce8aEwkkB

-> firecrawl (by firecrawl) turns any company website into clean text, so your Bot understands what each lead really does https://t.co/lvCEXZjPaS

-> crawl4ai (by unclecode) crawls websites and returns clean text your AI can read, for bigger research jobs https://t.co/nmB6ZL5bS8

-> gpt researcher (by assafelovic) an open source research agent that writes a full report with sources on any company or topic https://t.co/HTVnGpUxKi

-> twenty (by twentyhq) an open source CRM, so every lead and client lives in one place https://t.co/BDo2UpkGVw

-> https://t.co/DJcYOK1Emw (by calcom) open source scheduling, so your leads book a call by themselves https://t.co/LCMYZWANVl

-> n8n (by n8n-io) connects all the steps, from lead found to message drafted to call booked https://t.co/maKSmwUQXO

-> agent toolkit (by stripe) gives your agent Stripe actions like creating payment links, so you get paid https://t.co/o084aeCErN

the Bot finds the clients you close them

tweet.text:
sprite-stack-engine

Sprite stacks that stay solid as the camera turns and tilts

This small renderer uses plain WebGL2 with no libraries. It builds scenes from stacks of flat textured slices, with a camera that turns, tilts and zooms freely.

At street level, hidden-surface removal cuts written fragments from 103 to 1.09 per pixel.

Below a measured tilt, it automatically switches to voxel mode to keep stacks solid from any angle, including the ground.

Open index.html in a browser that supports WebGL2. There is nothing to install or build.

repos.description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.

tweet.text:
“4块钱两小时训出64M模型”，起初当营销吹，翻完MiniMind trainer目录才信。

预训练、SFT、LoRA、DPO、PPO/GRPO、Tool Use、Agentic RL 全躺在里面，还都是原生 PyTorch 手写的，trl 或 peft 那层壳压根没套。

结构是对着 Qwen3 来的。我在 3090 上粗粗估过，用 mini 数据组合跑完 1 epoch 差不多两个多小时，租卡成本确实压在个位数。回头看两年前的 nanoGPT，更像教学 demo；市面上多数教程又只停在推理和 LoRA 微调那一步。

后训练整条链路能摊开讲的仓库，MiniMind 算少数几个。想弄明白大模型到底怎么练出来的，从这儿下手比刷视频课实在。

repos.name: cloudflare/agents
repos.description: Build and deploy AI Agents on Cloudflare

tweet.text:
CLOUDFLARE HA BAJADO UN 99.9% LOS TOKENS QUE GASTA UN AGENTE AL USAR HERRAMIENTAS

El truco se llama Code Mode y está en su SDK oficial de agentes.

Si conectas un agente a una API grande por MCP, el modelo se tiene que tragar la definición de cada herramienta. En la API de Cloudflare son 2.5K endpoints: eso son 1.17 millones de tokens.

Con Code Mode el modelo no carga las 2.5K tools. Escribe código y solo usa dos funciones, buscar y ejecutar. Se queda en unos 1K tokens, da igual cuántos endpoints haya.

El repo es cloudflare/agents. Sirve para montar agentes con estado en Cloudflare.

→ Se duermen cuando no hacen nada y no cuestan nada mientras están parados
→ Pueden ser servidor MCP o conectarse como cliente
→ Code Mode: el modelo genera código en un worker aislado, no llama a las tools una a una
→ Tareas programadas, flujos con aprobación humana, voz y correo
→ Hooks de React para el front

Ojo: Code Mode sigue siendo experimental.

6.1K estrellas. Licencia MIT.
Última versión 0.34.1 (25 nov).

https://t.co/l4rdcaTiJj Cada vez que le pides a un agente de IA que lea una web abre un Chrome entero.

Es como alquilar un camión para llevar una carta.

Cloudflare acaba de liberar el navegador open source hecho solo para agentes.

Sin Chromium. Ni un proceso de Chrome ni un contenedor detrás.

Está escrito en Rust, compilado a WebAssembly y corre dentro de Cloudflare Workers. Lee el HTML, aplica el CSS, ejecuta el JavaScript de la página y te devuelve el resultado.

Habla el protocolo de Chrome DevTools, así que Puppeteer, Playwright o cualquier agente con MCP funciona sin cambiar nada.

6 de agosto: lo presentan en su Agents Week, gratis en beta dentro de Browser Run.
Septiembre: añaden soporte WebMCP y mejor compatibilidad.
13 de noviembre: liberan el código con licencia Apache 2.0.

Celso Martinho, de Cloudflare, bromeó con que quien creó Workers en 2017 no pensaba en meter un navegador entero ahí dentro.

Cloudflare dice que gasta entre 3 y 7 veces menos CPU y memoria que Chromium.

Arranca por petición y se destruye al terminar. No guarda estado. Nace, hace su tarea y muere.

Con agentes abriendo decenas de páginas a la vez se nota muchísimo la diferencia de gasto

Aunque tiene algunas desventajas: 

No es pixel perfect. Según quien lo ha probado, va como el doble de lento que Chrome y no pasa CAPTCHAs.

Para webs pesadas o con anti-bots, Chromium sigue mandando.

Y si quieres alojarlo tú, según su README necesitas plan de pago de Workers y ponerle Cloudflare Access delante porque no trae autenticación propia.

Cosillas que puedes montar con él:

1. Briefing diario: un agente en Claude Code lee 20 webs de tu nicho cada mañana y te deja un resumen.

2. Vigilante de competencia: un Worker con cron que guarda el HTML de sus páginas de precios y te avisa cuando cambian.

3. Capturas y PDFs en lote: le pasas una lista de URLs y te devuelve screenshots sin abrir un solo navegador.

4. Datos para tus directorios: renderiza páginas con JavaScript y extrae el contenido limpio para alimentar un directorio o un RAG.

5. Agentes en paralelo: cada agente con su propio navegador sin que se te funda la RAM.

Cómo probarlo en 2 minutos:

✅ Entra al playground, sin registro
✅ Pega cualquier URL y ábrela en DevTools
✅ O desde tu terminal: brew install cloudflare/cloudflare/kitesurf

Los agentes ya no necesitan un Chrome entero para leer una web de texto.

甚至还内置了会敲代码、会做动作的 AI 桌宠！

安卓用户里爱折腾 AI Agent 的，这个项目值得收着！

repos.name: obsproject/obs-studio
repos.description: OBS Studio - Free and open source software for live streaming and screen recording

tweet.text:
GTA 6 footage just pulled 7.9M views looking almost indistinguishable from real life.

you can recreate that look with 20 open-source GitHub repos.

here’s the complete AI video enhancement stack:

[ CAPTURE + UPSCALE ]

1. OBS Studio → capture gameplay footage
    https://t.co/1CxGMmIihP
2. PySceneDetect → split footage into clean shots
    https://t.co/YEeNN9Gi1l
3. Real-ESRGAN → upscale every frame
    https://t.co/UFsUMcAnnm
4. SeedVR → restore details across the entire clip
    https://t.co/brfeBNqA0O
5. Practical-RIFE → turn 30 FPS footage into smooth 60 FPS
    https://t.co/oVLnvJFAm8

[ DEPTH + TRACKING ]

6. Depth Anything V2 → generate depth maps for every frame
    https://t.co/JgSqFEvh5g
7. Video Depth Anything → maintain consistent depth across frames
    https://t.co/fYU2EmsS3o
8. SAM 2 → isolate cars, people, water, and objects
    https://t.co/wwOYAKZs0P
9. CoTracker → track points across video frames
    https://t.co/pJAeSnAMak
10. RAFT → calculate optical flow between frames
    https://t.co/QZTOdC8l2X

[ REALISM + LIGHTING ]

11. ControlNet → preserve scene geometry during visual changes
    https://t.co/I8BkpcclgA
12. IC-Light → relight scenes with realistic lighting and shadows
    https://t.co/9hmbvlB14s
13. PhotorealismEnhancement → Intel research for making GTA V look like real street footage
    https://t.co/XdDYuuMHui

[ AI VIDEO GENERATION ]

14. ComfyUI → connect the entire workflow
    https://t.co/Wx724jqoNx
15. VideoHelperSuite → load and export videos inside ComfyUI
    https://t.co/lhO409GVCd
16. Wan 2.2 → generate realistic video transformations
    https://t.co/qMwrSAdBf2
17. LTX-Video → create fast video-to-video drafts
    https://t.co/EQSzDYWm4T
18. HunyuanVideo → another open video generation model
    https://t.co/9zcUleFvn1

[ FINAL TOUCHES ]

19. OpenColorIO → give footage cinematic film color
    https://t.co/vLHdQLhk8V
20. FFmpeg → encode the final 4K video
    https://t.co/gGht2NpzCu

the workflow:

capture → upscale → depth → track → relight → re-render → grade → export.

Opus 5.5 handles the glue. these repos handle the heavy lifting.

20 repos. one photorealistic GTA 6 video pipeline.
